Pork is pork. Smoke it; it keeps for weeks. The tusks make excellent awls. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.

🔥 The fire settles. Marisol has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Brian says quietly "And you're still standing." Sigrun asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
